claim: At the tutorial NewGame tail, the original DOS caller reaches the actual f_22BF_0A65 fastcall body with AX=0 (window 0); if that body returns zero, o26_39C7_0000 is reached with AX=0 as well.

scope.rand_yard: controlled boundary sets MePlane=0..3, MeLocX=41, MeLocY=23; not a RandYard semantic claim
scope.window_fixture: DOS far handle table entries 0 and 1 point to separate 0x80-byte Win records; f_2505_0006 is original code, object count=0; flags are controlled and inverted across records.

interpretation: 04FE: lcall 015B:053C (SetMapPlane) with MePlane pushed on stack
0508: lcall 22BF:0A65 (fastcall f_22BF_0A65), with no argument push
0511: lcall 2CFF:2A10 (fastcall o26_39C7_0000), with no argument push
caller_bytes.fastcall_argument_register: AX, observed at actual callee entry

instruction_evidence: store AX to g_5AAE and g_5AAC
ax_zeroing_body.causal_role: The actual UpdateEdit body either returns false from win_IsWinOpen(0), or takes its draw path and ends in actual clip_Off; clip_Off explicitly zeroes AX after draw calls. The tested open-window path therefore leaves SetMapPlane/NewGame with AX=0 independent of modeled renderer return values.
